regions.name: Colorado
regions.setting: A box matching the state of Colorado: the Rocky Mountains, where the Colorado, Rio Grande, Arkansas and South Platte rivers rise, and the high plains to the east.

regions.name: Northern Alaska
regions.setting: Arctic tundra and permafrost: the North Slope and the Brooks Range, with a strip of interior Alaska to the south and a little of the Arctic Ocean.

regions.name: Southwestern Amazon (Rondônia)
regions.setting: Tropical rainforest with extensive land clearing since the 1980s. The box covers the Brazilian state of Rondônia and neighbouring parts of Bolivia and of other Brazilian states.

regions.name: Northern Morocco
regions.setting: Mediterranean-to-desert transition across the Atlas Mountains and the Atlantic plains. About a sixth of the box is sea.

regions.name: Central Sahel
regions.setting: Semi-arid belt between the Sahara and the West African savanna, from eastern Burkina Faso across southern Niger and northern Nigeria.

regions.name: Punjab and the north-west Indian plains
regions.setting: Intensively irrigated farmland of the upper Indus plain and north-west India, with part of the Thar Desert in the south and Himalayan foothills in the north-east.

regions.name: Malay Peninsula and Strait of Malacca
regions.setting: Humid equatorial land and sea with two monsoon seasons: Peninsular Malaysia, eastern Sumatra and the waters around them. About half of the box is sea.

regions.name: Southern Murray–Darling Basin
regions.setting: Australia's main agricultural river basin, prone to multi-year drought. The box covers its southern half and some land just outside it.

variables.name: Air temperature
variables.definition: Average air temperature two meters above the ground, about head height.

variables.name: Precipitation
variables.definition: Average rain and melted snow reaching the surface each day. MERRA-2 adjusts its modelled precipitation toward gauge and satellite observations.

variables.name: Humidity
variables.definition: Grams of water vapor in each kilogram of air near the ground.

variables.name: Wind speed
variables.definition: Average wind speed ten meters above the ground.

variables.name: Root-zone soil wetness
variables.definition: How full of water the top meter of soil is: 0 is completely dry, 1 is saturated.

variables.name: Vegetation greenness
variables.definition: A satellite measure of how much green, leafy vegetation covers the ground. It runs from about 0 (bare soil, snow, rock) to nearly 1 (dense green vegetation).

source.dataset: MERRA-2 (Modern-Era Retrospective analysis for Research and Applications, Version 2)
source.producer: NASA Global Modeling and Assimilation Office (GMAO)
source.access: NASA POWER Monthly and Annual API (NASA Langley Research Center)
source.kind: Reanalysis: a global model constrained by satellite and ground observations. Values are model-based estimates, not direct instrument readings.
source.caveat: MERRA-2 is a reanalysis: a model constrained by satellite and ground observations, not a direct measurement. Changes in the observing system over time (new satellites, fewer rain gauges) can create or hide trends, especially for precipitation and soil wetness. Check important results against an independent dataset.

mod13c2.dataset: MODIS/Terra Vegetation Indices Monthly L3 Global 0.05Deg CMG, Version 6.1 (MOD13C2)
mod13c2.producer: NASA MODIS Land Science Team; distributed by NASA LP DAAC
mod13c2.access: NASA LP DAAC (Earthdata); regional means computed by the team
mod13c2.kind: Satellite observation: a vegetation index computed from red and near-infrared reflectance measured by the MODIS instrument on NASA's Terra satellite.
mod13c2.caveat: NDVI is a satellite measurement of greenness, not a direct measure of plant health or biomass. Clouds, snow, smoke and low sun angles lower it, and it saturates over dense forest. The record starts in 2000, so it is shorter than the 1981-2025 weather variables and trends are harder to detect. The Terra satellite's overpass time has drifted earlier since 2020, which NASA reports is affecting recent data, so treat changes after about 2022 with extra care.
mod13c2.credit: NASA MODIS/Terra MOD13C2 v6.1 via NASA LP DAAC
